datasets.title: Budgets
datasets.description: One row per budget the connecting person may read, with the app definition of every bucket.

fields.name: parentId
fields.description: Parent budget, empty for a root.

fields.name: ownerName
fields.description: Owner display name; no email address.

fields.name: authorizedMinor
fields.description: Integer minor units of the row currency.

fields.name: allocatedOutMinor
fields.description: Integer minor units of the row currency.

fields.name: heldMinor
fields.description: Integer minor units of the row currency.

fields.name: preEncumberedMinor
fields.description: Pending. Integer minor units of the row currency.

fields.name: encumberedMinor
fields.description: Committed. Integer minor units of the row currency.

fields.name: actualMinor
fields.description: Integer minor units of the row currency.

fields.name: availableUnderRulesMinor
fields.description: Available under this budget rules, the definition the app shows.

fields.name: utilizationBps
fields.description: Utilization in basis points of the authorized amount.

datasets.title: Company roll-up
datasets.description: One row per root budget with company-wide Available, where a child allocation is counted once.

fields.name: authorizedMinor
fields.description: Integer minor units of the row currency.

fields.name: availableCompanyWideMinor
fields.description: Available, company-wide: authorized less held, pending, committed and actual over the whole subtree.

datasets.title: Ledger summary
datasets.description: Posted amounts by budget, accounting period and bucket. Single lines stay in BudgetFlow.

fields.name: bucket
fields.description: Ledger bucket the amount sits in.

fields.name: amountMinor
fields.description: Net posted to the bucket. Integer minor units of the row currency.

datasets.title: Events
datasets.description: Events funded from budgets the connecting person may read.

fields.name: estimateMinor
fields.description: Integer minor units of the row currency.

datasets.title: Requests
datasets.description: Spending requests on budgets the connecting person may read, with their status.

fields.name: amountMinor
fields.description: Integer minor units of the row currency.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When the request was raised, UTC.

body.notice: The feed is read-only and each connection carries its own sign-in, so a report never shows more than the person who built it can see.

tools.title: List my budgets
tools.description: Budgets you own or can see, each with Available under this budget rules. Read-only.

tools.title: Get a budget balance
tools.description: Authorized, pending, committed, actual and available for one budget you can see. Read-only.

tools.title: List my requests
tools.description: Spending requests you raised or can see, with their status. Read-only.

tools.title: Get a request status
tools.description: Where one request has got to. Read-only.

tools.title: List approvals waiting for me
tools.description: Approvals assigned to you, with title, amount and when they are due. It cannot decide any of them.

tools.title: Search events
tools.description: Events you can see, with their dates and status. Read-only.

body.consentText: Your AI assistant wants to read budgets, requests, approvals and events you can see in BudgetFlow. It cannot approve or change anything.
neverDoes: It cannot approve, reject, submit, apply a control or move money.
It never shows more than the person who connected it can see in BudgetFlow.

actions.title: Look up a budget balance
actions.description: Reads Available under this budget rules for a budget the connected person can see.

actions.title: Create a draft request
actions.description: Creates a Draft that stays a Draft until the person opens and submits it in BudgetFlow.

body.consentText: The platform wants to read budgets you can see and create drafts as you. It cannot approve, submit or move money.
neverDoes: It cannot approve, reject, submit, apply a control or move money.
It never shows more than the person who connected it can see in BudgetFlow.
